name: grid-spherical
title: Photo sphere
description: Cards sit tangent to a sphere. It assembles from its centre and turns a full orbit, then settles on one hero card and pushes in.

props.name: photos
props.doc: Photo file names inside public/photos, in order. Items take them in turn and repeat when there are more items than photos.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Small line at the bottom left. Empty for none.

props.name: showHud
props.doc: Show the caption and the counter.

props.name: aperture
props.doc: Depth of field: blur, in px, of a card one focus distance away from the focus plane. 0 keeps everything sharp.

props.name: drift
props.doc: Handheld drift on the camera, as a multiple of the default (about 0.4 degrees and 6 px). 0 for a locked-off camera.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius of the cards, px.

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Frame edge.

props.name: colors.ground2
props.doc: Frame centre, slightly lighter.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Caption type.

props.name: colors.edge
props.doc: Hairline round every card, or 'none' (the default) for clean edges.

props.name: count
props.doc: Cards on the sphere, spread evenly (a Fibonacci spiral).

props.name: radius3d
props.doc: Radius of the sphere, world px.

props.name: cardWidth
props.doc: Card width, world px.

props.name: cardHeight
props.doc: Card height, world px.

props.name: turns
props.doc: Extra full orbits the camera makes while it pulls out, on top of the half turn from the inside view to the hero's outside face.

props.name: insideFocal
props.doc: Focal length while the eye sits inside the sphere (smaller is wider). It widens to the outside focal as the camera pulls through the shell.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used only while the camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.

props.name: hero
props.doc: Index of the card the move ends on (a card near the equator reads best).

props.name: wideDistance
props.doc: Eye distance of the opening shot.

props.name: closeDistance
props.doc: Eye distance at the end of the push in.

props.name: backDim
props.doc: How much the far side of the sphere is darkened.
